title: 义务教育教科书·英语（川教）五年级上册

sentences.cn: 这是谁的课本？是我的。
sentences.en: Whose textbook is this? It is mine.

sentences.cn: 这个笔记本是你的，那本故事书是她的。
sentences.en: This notebook is yours, and that storybook is hers.

sentences.cn: 我的练习册在这儿，他的在书包里。
sentences.en: My workbook is here, and his is in the bag.

sentences.cn: 请一个接一个地读这些生词。
sentences.en: Please read the new words one by one.

sentences.cn: 美术很容易，但数学对我来说很难。
sentences.en: Art is easy, but maths is difficult.

sentences.cn: 我喜欢音乐课，因为它很有趣。
sentences.en: I enjoy music because it is funny.

sentences.cn: 科学课既有趣又有用。
sentences.en: Science is interesting and useful.

sentences.cn: 这个电脑游戏既无聊又没用。
sentences.en: This computer game is boring and useless.

sentences.cn: 你最喜欢的学科是什么？
sentences.en: What is your favourite subject?

sentences.cn: 体育和思想品德也是很重要的学科。
sentences.en: PE and ME are important subjects too.

sentences.cn: 社会课是我最喜欢的课。
sentences.en: Social studies is my favourite class.

sentences.cn: 我们在美术课上努力学习。
sentences.en: We work hard in the art class.

sentences.cn: 太棒了！魔术表演就在我们班。
sentences.en: Cool! The magic show is in our class.

sentences.cn: 我们老师说科学很容易学。
sentences.en: Our teacher says science is easy to learn.

sentences.cn: 我们年级有一百名学生。
sentences.en: There are one hundred pupils in our grade.

sentences.cn: 一千是一个很大的数。
sentences.en: One thousand is a very big number.

sentences.cn: 我爸爸在工作，我妈妈在睡觉。
sentences.en: My father is working, and my mother is sleeping.

sentences.cn: 孩子们正在游泳池里游泳。
sentences.en: The children are swimming in the pool.

sentences.cn: 她正在唱歌，他正在吃苹果。
sentences.en: She is singing, and he is eating an apple.

sentences.cn: 他们正在客厅里看电视。
sentences.en: They are watching TV in the living room.

sentences.cn: 我正在听音乐、看书。
sentences.en: I am listening to music and reading a book.

sentences.cn: 我的书少了两页。
sentences.en: Two pages are missing from my book.

sentences.cn: 你能解开这个谜题吗？小菜一碟。
sentences.en: Can you solve this puzzle? It is a piece of cake.

sentences.cn: 蝴蝶有身体和一对翅膀。
sentences.en: A butterfly has a body and a pair of wings.

sentences.cn: 你会拼写“蜻蜓”这个词吗？
sentences.en: Can you spell the word "dragonfly"?

sentences.cn: 昆虫是软的，石头是硬的。
sentences.en: An insect is soft, but a stone is hard.

sentences.cn: 瓢虫是一种小昆虫。
sentences.en: A ladybug is a small insect.

sentences.cn: 大多数昆虫能在天上飞。
sentences.en: Most insects can fly in the sky.

sentences.cn: 盒子里什么也没有。
sentences.en: There is nothing in the box.

sentences.cn: 请告诉我答案。
sentences.en: Please tell me the answer.

sentences.cn: 不，我今天没有迟到。
sentences.en: No, I am not late today.

sentences.cn: 是的，我现在准备好了。
sentences.en: Yes, I am ready now.

sentences.cn: 富士山在日本。
sentences.en: Mount Fuji is in Japan.

sentences.cn: 埃菲尔铁塔在法国。
sentences.en: The Eiffel Tower is in France.

sentences.cn: 大本钟是伦敦的一座大钟。
sentences.en: Big Ben is a big clock in London.

sentences.cn: 长城又长又古老。
sentences.en: The Great Wall is very long and old.

sentences.cn: 金门大桥在美国。
sentences.en: The Golden Gate Bridge is in America.

sentences.cn: 我的卧室里有一个钟和一盏台灯。
sentences.en: There is a clock and a lamp in my bedroom.

sentences.cn: 我的床在书桌和椅子旁边。
sentences.en: My bed is next to the desk and the chair.

sentences.cn: 电视机在房间里，靠近书架。
sentences.en: The TV is in the room, near the bookshelf.

sentences.cn: 那位穿紫色衣服的女士是我妈妈。
sentences.en: The woman in purple is my mother.

sentences.cn: 那个男人是我爸爸。
sentences.en: That man is my father.

sentences.cn: 我的堂弟在这张全家福里。
sentences.en: My cousin is in this family photo.

sentences.cn: 我的爷爷和奶奶和我们住在一起。
sentences.en: My grandfather and grandmother live with us.

sentences.cn: 今天公园里有很多人。
sentences.en: Many people are in the park today.

sentences.cn: 我姑姑是一名舞蹈演员。
sentences.en: My aunt is a dancer.

sentences.cn: 我叔叔是一家大饭店的厨师。
sentences.en: My uncle is a cook in a big hotel.

sentences.cn: 男警察和女警察帮助人们。
sentences.en: The policeman and the policewoman help people.

sentences.cn: 医生和护士在医院工作。
sentences.en: The doctor and the nurse work in the hospital.

sentences.cn: 我爸爸是一名公交车司机。
sentences.en: My father is a bus driver.

sentences.cn: 那名工人在工厂里。
sentences.en: The worker is in the factory.

sentences.cn: 她是一名歌唱家，唱得很好。
sentences.en: She is a singer, and she sings well.

sentences.cn: 他爸爸是一名出租车司机。
sentences.en: His father is a taxi-driver.

sentences.cn: 每个小学生教室里都有一张书桌。
sentences.en: Every pupil has a desk in the classroom.

sentences.cn: 我的房间很小，但非常干净。
sentences.en: My room is small but very clean.
